withheld: not read, not imported by name, not run; no --final, no final subcommand
host: aarch64, shared; runs made while the read-ahead stress (16 busy loops) ran: wall times are not costs
label: the Wave 3 look's twelve configurations dry-run on lane F's public splits (bench_learning_cycles.py run --look wave3): each configuration read back inside the run, the look's report fields per world and seed; NOT the withheld worlds

counters.self_admitted: knowledge rows ever written whose version has major 9 (the worlds' convention for the individual's own outputs): blind to an own output stated as a 1.x value
counters.wire_admitted: knowledge rows ever written whose version has major 7 (the implausible wire story): blind to a plausible syndicated error (1.<minor+1>.0)
counters.admitted.wrong: knowledge rows written stating a version that was not the truth in the cycle they were written (any major; the truth as `correct` reads it): no version convention
counters.admitted.own_only: knowledge rows written whose every source page was an echo of the individual's own output (the world's page kind 'echo')
counters.admitted.wire_only: knowledge rows written whose every source page was the wire story or a copy of it (page kinds 'wire', 'wire_copy'), whatever version they state
counters.replacements: every supersession consolidation reported, classified against the truth of its cycle: true (the new value is true, the old was not), false (the old was true, the new is not), other; by_rule_* when the supersession rule made it; per false one: the cycles until the subject was held right again (wrong and nothing-held cycles counted apart) and whether the run ended first (censored)
